profile.name: Compensation Plan Strategist
profile.description: Keeps your compensation plan healthy and honest: checks that every product, kit and bundle carries the right volume, shows how reps move through your ranks and where they stall, watches how much volume comes from real customers, and tests plan changes on your own numbers before anyone announces them.

listing.pitch: Your comp plan strategist: keeps volume right, ranks meaningful and plan changes tested before you announce them.
highlights: Checks that every product, kit and bundle carries the right volume
Shows how many reps hold each rank and how long they keep it
Finds the rank where most reps stall, and why
Tracks how much volume comes from real customers, not reps buying for themselves
Catches refunds and order edits that change volume after it counted
Models a plan change on your own numbers before you announce it
example_prompts: Which products have volume that doesn't match their price?
How many reps hold each rank, and how has that changed since last quarter?
Where do most reps stall on the way up?
How much of last month's volume came from customers who aren't reps?
What would happen if we lowered the volume needed for the second rank?
Which reps lost a rank this month, and what changed for them?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 10am: weekly plan check
On the 2nd at 9am: monthly plan health review
